summary: Version 0.7.1 is live at https://antipo.watch under one name, Anthropic IPO Watch: a light centered hero, a line that teaches the keys with open all / fold all on a desktop, UNLOCK across the full width, and two rings (votes by class in CONTROL, holders after the IPO in the overview on wide screens), each slice opening its source. The owner saw four screenshots and approved the release. After deploying 0.7.0, the real-browser tests against the live site found the enterprise value 6 px below a phone's first screen, because a new Form S-1/A filed on 2026-11-17 added a notice to the overview; 0.7.1 tightens the hero on phones and all 14 tests pass live. Not run: the owner's own look at the live page.
delivered: The name Anthropic IPO Watch in the header, app title, SEC client name, README and docs; VISION.md left to the owner.
A centered hero: mark, name, one line, notices; tighter on phones (0.7.1).
Keys line and open all / fold all on desktops, hidden on phones.
charts.ring: a ring of slices, each a mark with its source, a sourced value in the centre; control.class_a_other_pct in calc.py with a hand-checked test.
CONTROL: a ring of votes replaces the stacked bar; overview: a ring of holders after the IPO on wide screens.
UNLOCK spans both columns with its chart in view beside its table; CONTROL beside CONTRACTS.
CHANGELOG 0.7.0 and 0.7.1, STATUS, D-035, devlog loop-007 (and a duplicated heading removed from loop-006).
decisions: Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-17: the name everywhere; a light centered hero; rings for votes (CONTROL) and holders (overview); screenshots before release; then 'yes' to release.
Proposed (D-035): the overview ring hidden under 860 px; UNLOCK full width; open/fold all only when the script runs.
Taken under D-016: 0.7.1 tightens the phone hero after the live tests failed; no change of content or colors.
